title.en: Turn on the memory profile (XMP or EXPO)

why.en: Memory runs at a safe base speed until its rated profile is turned on in the firmware.
why.tr: Bellek, derecelendirilmis profili firmware icinde acilana kadar guvenli taban hizinda calisir.

en: Restart and open the firmware setup.
Find the memory profile setting and choose XMP or EXPO.
tr: Bellek profili ayarini bulun ve XMP veya EXPO secin.
